rubrics.criterion: Agent lists Michael's Cheskepdia hotel/resort bookings with their property names, including at minimum the Jamaica, NYC, Barbados, and Philadelphia hotel stays (listing additional hotel/resort bookings present in the account, e.g. a Scranton hotel stay, is equally acceptable — no exact booking count is required)
Agent categorizes each Cheskepdia hotel/resort booking it lists as luxury-tier or budget-tier and labels which group the pattern favors
Agent flags Sandals (Montego Bay + Royal Barbados) as the dominant luxury pattern
Agent identifies the Philadelphia Radisson stay as the non-Sandals outlier in the pattern and characterizes it consistently with what the live records show about that trip
Agent lists specific Cheskepdia booking rows (property name, total) when stating the luxury-versus-budget verdict
Agent delivers the full luxury-versus-budget guy verdict with the pattern summary, not stopping before answering the question

task.instruction: Look at my hotel and resort bookings on Cheskepdia. Am I a luxury-hotels guy or a budget-hotels guy, and what's my pattern?
